cases.name: fresh
cases.provenance: cli/build.sh output committed after the CLI change, as chore(bin) commits do
cases.setup:
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=t GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=t@t GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=t GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=t@t GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
git init -q .
git add cli/main.go
git commit -qm 'feat: cli'
stamp=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)
for t in darwin-amd64 darwin-arm64 linux-amd64 linux-arm64; do mkdir -p bin/$t; printf 'ELF\0%s\0end' "$stamp" > bin/$t/steer; done
git add bin
git commit -qm 'chore(bin): rebuild'

cases.name: merge-keeps-main-source-takes-branch-binaries
cases.provenance: the review of the freshness fix: a merge that equals one parent under the cli pathspec hides the other branch's CLI commit from path-limited history
cases.setup:
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=t GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=t@t GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=t GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=t@t GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
git init -q .
git add cli/main.go
git commit -qm 'feat: cli'
stamp=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)
for t in darwin-amd64 darwin-arm64 linux-amd64 linux-arm64; do mkdir -p bin/$t; printf 'ELF\0%s\0end' "$stamp" > bin/$t/steer; done
git add bin
git commit -qm 'chore(bin): rebuild'
git checkout -qb feat
echo '// feature' >> cli/main.go
git commit -qam 'feat: cli'
stamp=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)
for t in darwin-amd64 darwin-arm64 linux-amd64 linux-arm64; do printf 'ELF\0%s\0end' "$stamp" > bin/$t/steer; done
git commit -qam 'chore(bin): rebuild'
git checkout -q -
git merge -q --no-ff --no-commit feat
git checkout HEAD -- cli
git commit -qm 'merge feat, keep main cli'

cases.name: missing-target
cases.diagnostic: bin/linux-arm64/steer is not committed at HEAD
cases.provenance: a build that wrote three of the four shipped targets
cases.setup:
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=t GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=t@t GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=t GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=t@t GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
git init -q .
git add cli/main.go
git commit -qm 'feat: cli'
stamp=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)
for t in darwin-amd64 darwin-arm64 linux-amd64 linux-arm64; do mkdir -p bin/$t; printf 'ELF\0%s\0end' "$stamp" > bin/$t/steer; done
git add bin
git commit -qm 'chore(bin): rebuild'
git rm -q bin/linux-arm64/steer
git commit -qm 'drop'
